_comment: Sets tracked by the app. 'priced' sets have a confidently identified Cardmarket expansion; the rest are listed so their cards can still be collected, but carry no prices rather than guessed ones. anchorNames fingerprint the expansion and expansionId is the cached result, re-verified on every build. See PRICE-MAPPING-NOTES.md.
